title: fields:create with a field interface and no data type answers 500 unsupported field type null
statement: The manual says each field interface carries a default data type (Number defaults to double). The API applies no such default: POST /api/collections/<c>/fields:create {name, interface:'number'} answers 500 unsupported field type null. The identical request with type:'double' answers 200, so the default the manual describes exists only in the browser form.

handVerified.note: Report section 4. Probe and control both quoted verbatim. The report ADDS the mechanism cite (database.ts:779, a bare Error rather than a typed one, which is why koa renders it 500 and not 400).

source.howDecided: git log d8d8cb4b..origin/main -- <culprit files> returned 0 commits for every file in this finding. The only three commits since the tested SHA are 24a620efb8 and 032a4f6913 (lerna version bumps, packages/*/package.json and lerna.json only) and ba00bcebc2 (CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md). The culprit lines were then re-read at origin/main and match the report's quotes.

reevaluation: The finding stands unchanged. database.ts has no commit since the tested SHA and line 779 still reads throw Error(`unsupported field type ${type}`) inside `if (!Field)`. The doc sentence is still verbatim at docs/docs/en/data-sources/data-modeling/collection-fields/index.md:64. The symptom search returned four older items and none is this bug (#8143 and #9627 are upgrade start-up failures, #9983 is an external data-source UI fix, #2837 is a 2023 render failure). Two defects are stacked here and a filer should say so: the missing interface-to-type default, and the untyped Error that turns a bad request into a 500. Either one alone is filable; together they make one clean report.
notes: Ask for the 400 first and the default second: a maintainer may reasonably answer that type is required at the API and that the doc sentence describes the form, in which case unsupported field type null is still a 500 where a 400 belongs. Quote the doc line so the interface-default half is anchored to their own text.
